title: feat(cell-cutting): single-fiber cover rigidity, the induced symmetry group of the fourteen-solution system (cycle 791)
science: Cycle 791: on ONE sample wall fiber, the complete group of row permutations preserving its cover instance, the group it induces on the 14 fold-held cuttings (order 2), the fact that no free involution exists among the induced elements, and that the only geometrically carried induced element is the identity - so no permutation symmetry of that instance carries the parity of fourteen.
